title: Does Slime App Count!?!
author: aggie_hero7
selftext:
For the Slime Lovers and Smiles

Slime Lovers, Goo Heads, Moms Dads or fellow kin who just like the eewie gooey sounds. I spent about six months building a Slime Recipe App and apparently it might be for you. 

Why Slime? Because I like making things but I wanted to make something that would allow me to have more fun with my two little kiddos. I found myself fumbling over my phone struggling to make slime one day (I thought making my own would be cheaper than going to the mall). It occurred to me this probably happens to other folks who work hard - have precious too little time to make memories with loved ones and maybe just want to pop their phone open, grab a box off the shelf, and make something weird that offers tactile delights and earn a smile.

Is this going to be the Betty Crocker Recipe Book for Slime of the 2020s? Probably not. Will it be a huge success? Unlikely. Will it hopefully share some of the joy I’ve been able to find with my family in doing this silly activity with others? I hope so. 

I goo influence (this is a good mid-life crisis) once a week so check out WunderGoo on your preferred media platform.

iPhone and iPad: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6813781702

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.boldvibeslabs.wundergoo

Web: https://app.wundergoo.com

It started as a list of recipes that I could easily pull up on my phone. Then let me kids pick one. Then we make it. No fiddling, searching, banging on AI asking for advice. Easy to follow steps for a Buffon like myself.

Classic slime is free and needs no account. The Family Pass is one payment for one year, and it does not renew on its own. It’s $1 a month 😂

Thanksgiving recipes for US families coming in November.

If you want to share a recipe, ask a question, are curious why my I’m even bothering hmu at hello@wundergoo.com or one of my limited media outlets.
